subject.title: fix(copilot): bound BYOK proxy request bodies

question: Should Copilot BYOK loopback traffic permanently use an unconditional 16 MiB body limit and 30 second read timeout?
rationale: The patch is mechanically focused, but choosing limits changes the supported behavior of an existing SDK-facing local proxy and cannot be resolved from the supplied implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Confirm the proposed limits
options.body: Accept 16 MiB and 30 seconds as the supported Copilot BYOK ingress contract and merge with the existing regression coverage.

options.title: Align with a shared contract
options.body: Replace the local constants with the established ingress defaults or documented Copilot limits, then preserve the overflow and timeout behavior tests.

options.title: Pause pending workload evidence
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers can confirm representative BYOK request sizes and slow-upload behavior.

recommendation.title: Confirm the proposed limits
recommendation.body: Accept 16 MiB and 30 seconds as the supported Copilot BYOK ingress contract and merge with the existing regression coverage.
